name: What documentation do I need for a roof insurance claim?

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need for a roof insurance claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: To streamline your roof insurance claim, you'll typically need your insurance policy number, the date the damage occurred, and a description of the damage. Providing photos or videos of the damage, if available, can also be helpful. Discounted Roofing Co. assists by providing a detailed written estimate and documentation of the damage we observe during our inspection to support your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need your policy number, damage date, and description; photos and a contractor's estimate are also valuable.
